limitations: Four benchmark processes per comparison do not establish a confidence interval; earlier runs overlapped compilation and are excluded from claimed improvement
Trace samples two cores of the double-buffer candidate and can perturb execution; issue/stall fractions are not full-array peak-compute utilization
DMA port defaults sample channel 0, not every weight DMA channel; bandwidth remains unmeasured
Current prefill is sequential resident replay, not a batched NPU prefill
Baseline is BF16, not IEEE FP16; precision clarification was requested and remains unanswered
No INT8 accuracy, long-context language-quality or hardware-roofline claim is made
